name: E3RelaxH2 (high-degree, high-order equivariant GNN for direct crystal structure optimization)
subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
capability_it_enables: Maps an unrelaxed crystal directly to its DFT-relaxed structure (atomic positions and lattice parameters) in a single equivariant forward pass, avoiding iterative DFT relaxation. Pretrained checkpoints (c2db, mp, xmno) and datasets are released on Zenodo.
verbatim_quote: E3RelaxH2 is an E(3)-equivariant graph neural network that predicts relaxed crystal structures (atomic positions and lattice parameters) from unrelaxed inputs in a single forward pass.

name: GREPO (graph neural network benchmark + GNN retrievers/rerankers for repository-level bug localization)
subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
capability_it_enables: Provides the first GNN benchmark for repository-scale bug localization (86 Python repos, 47,294 bug-fixing tasks) together with official GNN retriever/reranker training and evaluation code and a dataset on ModelScope, enabling graph-structured code reasoning for software engineering.
verbatim_quote: This repository is the official code implementation for the paper 'GREPO: A Benchmark for Graph Neural Networks on Repository-Level Bug Localization'.

name: Tensor Channel Equivariant Graph Neural Networks (molecular polarizability prediction)
subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
capability_it_enables: Directly predicts full molecular polarizability tensors by augmenting a PaiNN-style equivariant message-passing network with explicit symmetric rank-2 tensor channels aligned with the isotropic/anisotropic decomposition of polarizability.
verbatim_quote: a tensor-channel equivariant graph neural network for direct prediction of molecular polarizability tensors, building on the efficient PaiNN architecture and augmenting the hidden representation with explicit symmetric rank-2 tensor channels aligned with the decomposition of polarizability into isotropic and anisotropic components

name: GraphBFF (Billion-Scale Graph Foundation Models)
subfield: Graph neural networks / geometric deep learning
capability_it_enables: An end-to-end recipe (GraphBFF Transformer) for training billion-parameter graph foundation models on arbitrary heterogeneous billion-scale graphs, establishing neural scaling laws for general graphs and achieving strong zero-shot/probing transfer to unseen node- and link-level tasks (up to +31 PRAUC points).
verbatim_quote: GraphBFF (Graph Billion-Foundation-Fusion), the first end-to-end recipe for building billion-parameter Graph Foundation Models for arbitrary heterogeneous, billion-scale graphs

name: Molmo2 (open-weight vision-language model with video understanding and pointing/grounding)
capability_it_enables: Open-weight VLM family (Molmo2-4B, Molmo2-8B, Molmo2-O-7B) with state-of-the-art point-driven visual grounding across single-image, multi-image, and video tasks; full code, pretrain/SFT checkpoints, and 9 new datasets are released.
verbatim_quote: Molmo2 is state-of-the-art among open-source models and demonstrates exceptional new capabilities in point-driven grounding in single image, multi-image, and video tasks

name: InternVL-U (unified multimodal model for understanding, reasoning, generation, and editing)
capability_it_enables: A single lightweight 4B-parameter unified multimodal model that performs multimodal understanding, reasoning, image generation, and image editing in one framework, outperforming prior open-source unified baselines on generation/editing while retaining strong understanding. Inference code and a HuggingFace checkpoint are released.
verbatim_quote: InternVL-U is a 4B-parameter unified multimodal model (UMM) that brings multimodal understanding, reasoning, image generation, image editing into a single framework

name: VLA Foundry (unified single-codebase framework for training LLM -> VLM -> VLA models)
capability_it_enables: An open-source framework unifying LLM, VLM, and VLA training in one shared stack (language pretraining through action-expert fine-tuning), supporting both from-scratch training and HuggingFace pretrained backbones; trained LLM/VLM/VLA model weights (e.g. Foundry-VLA-1.7B-sim) are released on HuggingFace.
verbatim_quote: VLA Foundry is an open-source framework that unifies LLM, VLM, and VLA training in a single codebase.

name: Health-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Models (malfunction-aware robot control)
capability_it_enables: Adds a Health Projector module to a VLA so the policy takes a health vector (per-joint operating angle and torque capability) as input and adapts its action predictions to complete tasks even with degraded/failing robot joints. Note: repo states code and dataset will be released later, so no usable code yet.
verbatim_quote: malfunction-aware (health-conditioned) VLA that takes a health vector as an input that gives information about robots' joints' operation angle and torque capability, and adapts its predictions to complete the tasks with the degraded joints
